Accomplishment

1. Founder and First Chairman of Texas Formosan Federal Credit Union (德州台灣信用合作社創辦人和第一任社長) 1975, Served 22 Years as Chairman and BoardMember.

2. Acting President of Taiwanese Association of America (全美台灣同鄉會代理會長) , and Assisted to Organize 8 Taiwanese Credit Unions 1977 –1978.

3. Board Member of Taiwanese Heritage Society of Houston (台灣人傳統基金會理事), Purchased the Community Center, and served as First Director (主任) 1992-1994.

4. Local presidents for TAA, FAPA, FAHR, WUFI-USA.

5. One of four Outstanding Asian American Volunteers honored by Houston Metro Transit Authority (休士頓公車處) in observation of Asian American Heritage Month (May) 1998.

6. Commitment to Leadership Award by The United Way in Houston (休士頓聯合公益基金會的領導卓越獎) 1999

7. Published 6Hanji Booksa nd Many Articles in Taiwanese American Newspapers, such as 德州台灣信用合作社專集；休士頓台獨運動的故事；台美人休士頓的腳印

8. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 09/2018
